title: Alembic migrations setup
description: Initialize Alembic in app/db/migrations/ and generate the initial migration for positions, account, and ohlcv_cache tables. Migrations are excluded from the coverage gate (pyproject.toml [tool.coverage.run] omit). Note: app/main.py's lifespan hook already calls Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine) as an interim stopgap (see docs/architecture/Backend.md §7 and the api-portfolio-add-position task's decisions) — any fresh install before this task lands will already have tables created by create_all, not by a migration.

checklist.step: Run alembic init against app/db/migrations/, wire env.py to app.db.models.Base.metadata and app.config settings
Generate the initial autogenerate migration covering PositionORM, AccountORM, OHLCVCacheORM
Verify `alembic upgrade head` produces the expected schema against a throwaway SQLite file

Against a database that already has tables from the create_all stopgap (see description), run `alembic stamp head` instead of `alembic upgrade head` — a blind upgrade would try to CREATE TABLE against tables that already exist and fail. Verify this path too, not just the fresh-file case above.
Document the migration workflow (how to generate/run migrations) — where this lives is a decision for whoever picks this up: README vs a doc
